paragraph: Alpine is a single-family market and a thin one, with five closings over six months at a median of $4,500,000. Sales ran from $4,000,000 to $7,300,000, so the median is the number to anchor on. The typical sale is a six-bedroom colonial with six full baths. The sale-to-list ratio came in at 0.96, nothing sold above asking, and the median days on market was 101, so buyers have room to negotiate here and sellers need to price with intent. That is normal at this price point. Five sales spread across three months is too small to read a monthly trend, so treat the six-month picture as the picture. If you are buying in Alpine, expect a long, deliberate process on both sides rather than competition on the good ones.
